status: review only; proposal not implemented or physically qualified

primary_reference.title: The envelope of passive motion allowed by the capsular ligaments of the hip
primary_reference.sample_and_protocol: Nine normal cadaveric left hips; aggregate intact peri-articular restraint, functional loading, 5 Nm rotational restraint. Not specimen-specific calibration.

separate_2017_reference.title: Effects of hip joint transverse plane range of motion with a modeled effusion and capsular tear: A cadaveric study
separate_2017_reference.context: Ten hips; 1.5 Nm endpoint. Full extension: external 27.3 +/- 5.2 deg, internal 21.1 +/- 4.5 deg. At 90 deg flexion: external 27.4 +/- 4.4 deg, internal 38.8 +/- 5.9 deg.
separate_2017_reference.distinction: Different specimens, protocol and lower torque endpoint. Keep separate; do not blend into the 2015 5 Nm toe fit.

graph_read.coordinate: f is flexion in degrees; extension negative; F0 = 0 deg; A0 neutral ab/adduction

slack_width.caveat: Linear interpolation of approximate Figure 4 reads; not a published regression, CI or measured law.

toe_tangent.caveat: Reusing the rounded F0 point across extension is explicit inference, not an EXT fit; it reaches 5 Nm about 4.5 deg earlier than the EXT graph read and is not uniformly conservative.
toe_tangent.direction_choice: Same toe and tangent on both rotational branches is a reduced symmetric-toe assumption; only mid-slack center preserves the measured shift. Not full direction-specific capsule behavior.

reduced_candidate_equations.resisting_torque_magnitude: T(g)=A*g^2+B*g^3; applied generalized torque opposes increasing g

nominal.equations: A=(15-K*x)/x^2; B=(K*x-10)/x^3; at x=x5 these give T=5 Nm and dT/dg=K

limitations: Approximate aggregate figure reads with sampling spread; not patient-specific.
Only near-neutral extension through F0 and A0. No flexion beyond F0, off-neutral ab/adduction, translation, combined-axis coupling, or individual capsule anatomy is supported.
No law implementation or native/physical validation is claimed.

source_xml.pelvis_local_frame: Pelvis authored Euler 1.57 -1.57 0. ASI x=+0.0095 and PSI x=-0.155 support +X anterior; side markers use right z positive and left z negative.

derivation.right: (+Y) cross (+X anterior) = -Z; right lateral is +Z, so positive q moves anterior toward medial.
derivation.left: (-Y) cross (+X anterior) = +Z; left lateral is -Z, so positive q moves anterior toward medial.
derivation.result: Positive compiled hip-rotation q is internal on both sides, verified from each authored axis and side landmarks rather than assumed mirrored signs.

mapped_rest_frame_check.method: Rotate each compiled parent-frame axis, authored anterior +X and the side-specific lateral +/-Z by the pinned pelvis XYZW orientation, then evaluate axis cross anterior and its dot with medial (-lateral).
mapped_rest_frame_check.interpretation: Both dot products are +1 within floating-point roundoff, confirming positive compiled q moves anterior medially in the mapped rest frame on each side.
mapped_rest_frame_check.orientation_source_note: The source pelvis inertial declaration has no quat, and the femur child bodies are translation-only with the hip joints at default q=0. In this source the pelvis default inertial world quaternion therefore gives the pelvis/body orientation used for the zero-pose axis mapping. The separate compiled axis_parent_frame and q-index rows remain the authoritative source-to-runtime mapping.

qualification_boundary: Literature/source sign review only. No code changed; no capsule parameter implemented, native run performed, or physical qualification claimed.
